verses.en: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.pt: Lembra-te, Senhor, a bem de Davi, de todas as suas aflições;
verses.en_web: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Lord, give thought to David, and to all his troubles;

verses.en: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.pt: como jurou ao Senhor, e fez voto ao Poderoso de Jacó, dizendo:
verses.en_web: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.en_bbe: How he made an oath to the Lord, and gave his word to the great God of Jacob, saying,

verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.pt: Não entrarei na casa em que habito, nem subirei ao leito em que durmo;
verses.en_web: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I will not come into my house, or go to my bed,

verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.pt: não darei sono aos meus olhos, nem adormecimento às minhas pálpebras,
verses.en_web: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
verses.en_bbe: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or rest to my eyeballs,

verses.en: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.pt: até que eu ache um lugar para o Senhor uma morada para o Poderoso de Jacó.
verses.en_web: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.en_bbe: Till I have got a place for the Lord, a resting-place for the great God of Jacob.

verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.pt: Eis que ouvimos falar dela em Efrata, e a achamos no campo de Jaar.
verses.en_web: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:
verses.en_bbe: We had news of it at Ephrathah: we came to it in the fields of the wood.

verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.pt: Entremos nos seus tabernáculos; prostremo-nos ante o escabelo de seus pés.
verses.en_web: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
verses.en_bbe: Let us go into his tent; let us give worship at his feet.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, Senhor, entra no lugar do teu repouso, tu e a arca da tua força.
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place; you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.en_bbe: Come back, O Lord, to your resting-place; you and the ark of your strength.

verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.pt: Vistam-se os teus sacerdotes de justiça, e exultem de júbilo os teus santos.
verses.en_web: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
verses.en_bbe: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints give cries of joy.

verses.en: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.pt: Por amor de Davi, teu servo, não rejeites a face do teu ungido.
verses.en_web: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your servant David, do not give up your king.

verses.en: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.pt: O Senhor jurou a Davi com verdade, e não se desviará dela: Do fruto das tuas entranhas porei sobre o teu trono.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord gave a true oath to David, which he will not take back, saying, I will give your kingdom to the fruit of your body.

verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.pt: Se os teus filhos guardarem o meu pacto, e os meus testemunhos, que eu lhes hei de ensinar, também os seus filhos se assentarão perpetuamente no teu trono.
verses.en_web: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
verses.en_bbe: If your children keep my word, and the teachings which I will give them, their children will be rulers of your kingdom for ever.

verses.en: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor escolheu a Sião; desejou-a para sua habitação, dizendo:
verses.en_web: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord's heart is on Zion, desiring it for his resting-place.

verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.pt: Este é o lugar do meu repouso para sempre; aqui habitarei, pois o tenho desejado.
verses.en_web: “This is my resting place forever. Here I will live, for I have desired it.
verses.en_bbe: This is my rest for ever: here will I ever be; for this is my desire.

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.pt: Abençoarei abundantemente o seu mantimento; fartarei de pão os seus necessitados.
verses.en_web: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.en_bbe: My blessing will be on her food; and her poor will be full of bread.

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.pt: Vestirei de salvação os seus sacerdotes; e de júbilo os seus santos exultarão
verses.en_web: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
verses.en_bbe: Her priests will be clothed with salvation; and her saints will give cries of joy.

verses.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.pt: Ali farei brotar a força de Davi; preparei uma lâmpada para o meu ungido.
verses.en_web: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.en_bbe: There I will make the horn of David fertile: I have made ready a light for my king.

verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.pt: Vestirei de confusão os seus inimigos; mas sobre ele resplandecerá a sua coroa.
verses.en_web: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will be resplendent.”
verses.en_bbe: His haters will be clothed with shame; but I will make his crown shining.
